meta.name: frame-flowchart-sticky
meta.description: SVG 曲线连接 + 便利贴节点 + 光标交互, 像白板 brainstorm

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在白板上绘制曲线连接和便利贴节点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在白板风格中快速绘制连接图和便签
copy.tagline_en: Draw curved connections and sticky notes on a whiteboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly draw connection diagrams and sticky notes in a whiteboard style

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会将你的流程或系统画成白板风格的便利贴流程图，包含手写体节点、彩色便利贴和 SVG 曲线连接线，并支持光标悬停交互。
howto.when: 当你描述一个流程、系统或工作流，并希望以白板便利贴风格可视化时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一个用户注册流程的便利贴流程图。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含 5-12 个节点的白板风格流程图。

say.text: 用便利贴风格展示系统架构，节点用黄色和薄荷色。
say.note: Claude 会分配颜色并生成连接线。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will draw your process or system as a whiteboard-style sticky note flowchart, with handwritten fonts, colorful sticky notes, and SVG curved connectors, plus hover interactions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a process, system, or workflow and want it visualized in a whiteboard sticky note style.

say_en.text: Draw a sticky note flowchart for user registration.
say_en.note: Claude generates a 5-12 node whiteboard-style flowchart.

say_en.text: Show system architecture with sticky notes, use yellow and mint colors.
say_en.note: Claude assigns colors and draws connectors.
